periods.label: Week of August 10, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Expanded PvP, New Controllers, and Account Management

features: Introduced Realm Challenges for competitive two-player encounters, allowing the winner to claim significant resources from the loser.
Implemented Swarm Mode, adding a realm header with a countdown, forcing queued enemies, and scaling server cooldowns per wave.
Expanded account management by allowing multiple characters and implementing a shared stash inventory across all linked heroes.
Added support for DualShock controllers, mapping face and shoulder buttons to all spell slots and providing camera-relative movement controls.
Enhanced the Devlog experience with new features including API status updates, ability to track bug fixes, and structured categories for feature requests.
bugfixes: Corrected the persistent aura system so that a unit's specialized group aura follows its owner's position accurately in the world.
Fixed specific visual glitches such as light rendering issues within swamp environments.
balance: Revised the mechanics of status effects (Poison, Bleed, Burn) to allow them to bypass player dodge and block. Additionally, Voodoo poison now scales its amplification up to 2x at level 99, while also adjusting block-related rules for guaranteed restoration.
Ameliorated Thunder Aura by doubling both its damage output and targeting radius, replacing the visual fill with inward lightning arcs.
ux: Improved the mobile user experience by ensuring that Devlog and enemy preview exit buttons remain accessible in the top-right corner without scaling the main HUD.
Updated leaderboards to rank heroes not just by level, but also by acquired Souls, and displayed current Soul totals alongside basic stats.
graphics: Enhanced combat immersion by introducing distinct sound cues for spells, attacks, gold drops, and creep deaths. A lightweight battle music loop now plays outside of training zones.
Added new player-facing options to automatically equip items and spells upon acquisition, filling only empty slots.

commits.title: feat(waves): add swarm mode
commits.description:
- add a realm-header toggle with countdown and tooltip
- force queued enemies and advance waves below the active-enemy cap

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
